chunks.content: Implemented OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE for a customer-facing web application.
Rotated JWT signing keys with zero downtime using a two-key overlap strategy and short access token TTLs.
Ran a lunchtime study group on the SICP textbook for six months.
Instrumented refresh-token reuse detection so a stolen token invalidates the whole family on the next call.
Ported a legacy session-cookie auth system to stateless bearer tokens across three services.
Wrote a small internal tool for parsing X.509 certificate chains during a security audit.

query: Backend engineer to harden our OAuth and JWT stack: key rotation, refresh-token security, and stateless auth patterns.
notes: Four relevant chunks (0 OAuth, 1 JWT rotation, 3 refresh-token security, 4 stateless auth). Chunk 5 is adjacent security work but not the ask. Chunk 2 is a distractor. Recall@K at K=3 must necessarily be < 1.0; at K=5 or K=8 it can reach 1.0 if all four are retrieved.
